EASY TO PICK UP
  1. 01

    Drag up from the ball. A longer swipe gives you a higher arc.

  2. 02

    Get over Charles’s hands. Watch him move, use a higher arc, and time your release.

  3. 03

    Aim with the dotted arc. Release to shoot. Long shots and streaks earn extra points.
